name: Billnest
summary: An eight-page invoicing and accounts app for freelancers and small studios
about: A calm, paper-and-ink invoicing dashboard for a small design studio. Write invoices with line items, discount and tax while a live preview updates beside you, send them, record payments and watch the Paid stamp land. Estimates turn into invoices, and expenses, payments and a profit and loss report keep the books in one place.
how: Use the tabs across the top: Overview, Invoices, Estimates, Clients, Expenses, Payments, Reports and Settings.
Click New invoice, pick a client, add lines, a discount and tax; the paper preview and totals update as you type.
Open an invoice and press Send: the paper folds and flies to the bell, and the status timeline moves on.
Record a payment; when it is paid in full the Paid stamp slams onto the invoice and the charts update.
Turn an accepted estimate into an invoice in one click, and nudge late clients from the Overview.
Switch the money chart between 3M, 6M and 12M, export CSVs, and change currency or invoice numbering in Settings.
